verdict.rationale: Unstructured supports 'High Res' and VLM-based partitioning strategies and generative OCR enrichment, which are relevant to scanned/photographed documents, but there is no explicit evidence about handling skewed pages, stamps, or low-quality scans specifically, nor any accuracy benchmarks or independent hands-on validation. missing for 10: evidence of deskewing/rotation correction, stamp/handwriting handling, accuracy metrics on low-quality scans, and independent third-party validation of OCR quality.
